title: Momoi Airi — To You Who Wants To Be An Idol〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: To You Who Wants To Be An Idol（4★）

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (No matter how you look at it, this is me from when I was little...)

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Look, a TV!
Some idols are dancing too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, you shouldn't run like that!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Why'd they have to put the TV way up there? I can't see anything from down here...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's probably a part of the exhibit. You know, to describe what's going on? Come here. Up you go.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I guess I can stick around a bit too. Let's see...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hold on, this is a video of that time I did a show with Nanamin...)

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Airi, is that you?! You're on TV!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (And I've seen all these costumes and idol merch before. I definitely have.)

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: I... I'm actually trying to become an idol!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: My little sister said that she can't help but smile whenever she sees me!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: That's why I want to go on a big stage and make everybody feel the same way! And, um...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's okay, just take your time.
You're such a little tomboy.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Oh, this might've been when I started feeling bothered by how everybody was saying I was too rambunctious or tomboyish...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I decided that I wanted to become an idol and started ignoring everything that those boys said about me...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I still have no idea where I am or what this place is...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But I'm certain that this little girl is me.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm sorry for calling you a little tomboy. Please, tell me more about why you want to become an idol.

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: But there are all these mean boys that keep teasing my little sister. I get mad and keep telling them to stop too...

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Then they said that a brat like me could never become an idol.

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: My mom even bought me some really cute-looking clothes, but whenever I wear them, the boys in my class tease me about it.

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: They tell me that I'm a big, mean monster and shouldn't be wearing girly clothes.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even though you're a girl in every sense of the word...

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Oh! There's a TV over there too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, I can see that. Wanna take a look?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: <Airi, you received another request for a variety show appearance. The filming is next Saturday.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <What? Isn't that the day of the mini-concert?>

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: <Yes, but the other members should be fine without you. We'll announce the change on our website.>

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: <Yes, that's right. I'd like Airi to start focusing on becoming more of a variety show personality...>

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: <Honestly, as an idol, she's pretty run of the mill, so I'd like to shift her work away from that...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Wait just a minute!
What's that supposed to mean?!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're right. I was really angry and really sad...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I worked so hard to become an idol and it's like everything was being taken away from me...)

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Is being an idol really hard...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, becoming an idol and staying that way are very difficult things to accomplish...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (And her seeing me fight with my manager probably isn't doing her motivation any favors either.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Do you see that dresser over there? How about we take a seat and have a little chat?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll even let you sit on my lap.

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Um, Airi...
What's the hardest part about being an idol?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The hardest part? Well, if you want to go on stage to sing and dance, you have to practice a lot.

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: That's okay! I love to sing and dance! Is there anything else?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, you have to always be smiling when the cameras are rolling and smile even more when you're on stage.

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Why?
Do you have to always smile that much?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Of course!
Idols are supposed to spread hope to others.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Look, some people will say mean things about you, not every show will go as planned and you'll have to get through some tough situations.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But here's something that one of my friends told me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Tomorrow will always be a better day!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Tomorrow will always be a better day...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly! Being able to overcome tough hurdles and face not so pretty situations gives idols the power to spread hope to their fans!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So just hang in there!
I know you can do it because you have us on your side!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In that sense, you're the perfect candidate for becoming an idol just the way you are! So don't let those boys get you down!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't let what others say discourage you. Not ever.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The most important thing that you need to do right now is believe that you'll become an idol someday.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes. As long as you don't give up, your dream will come true. I guarantee it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I mean, it's your dream!
Don't ever let go of it...!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
I promise that I'll become an idol!
I'm gonna become an idol, make lots and lots of people really happy!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Good, that's the spirit!
And I promise to become the best idol that I can be!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Little Airi
rows.Line:
I promise to become an idol!
I promise to be the best idol that I can be.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I promise to never let go too.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that I met Minori that day.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that I got to form MORE MORE JUMP! with her, Shizuku and Haruka too.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I've had my lows. Sometimes it was really low, but I've had just as many highs.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Hehe.
I'm so glad that I became an idol!)

rows.Speaker: Little Airi's Voice
rows.Line: I'm gonna try my best, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi's Voice
rows.Line: So promise to do your best too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I didn't know you were waiting here, Airi♪ Did you by chance happen to find a little ball of light?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I did! Wait, did you leave that for me here, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It must've been a fragment of a feeling...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: In SEKAI, fragments of feelings that are yet to manifest as a SEKAI of their own can appear here. Miku told me all about them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Did something happen when you touched that fragment, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I met someone I didn't expect to meet and made some wonderful discoveries!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Mhm... *Yawn*...
Huh? I'm back in my room?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow, I just had the strangest dream...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, that definitely wasn't a dream.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I clearly remember making a promise with that little girl.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And we're gonna do everything we can to spread those to more and more people...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Starting by doing my best today!
